example.content:
const pcbUuid = await eda.dmt_Pcb.createPcb();
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));

const deleted = await eda.dmt_Pcb.deletePcb(pcbUuid);
console.log('deleted:', deleted);

_source.title: 删除 PCB
_source.remarks.text.0: 如若 PCB 已关联复用模块（在工程库内存在同名的复用模块符号），则删除 PCB 时将同步删除关联的原理图和复用模块符号，复用模块符号不可删除则跳过
_source.example.text.0: 1. 创建专用测试 PCB（避免误删工程里的现有 PCB），等 1.5s 同步
_source.example.text.2: 3. 回读确认已删除（返回 undefined 说明 PCB 已不存在）

title: Delete PCB
remarks.text.0: If the PCB is already associated with a reuse block (a reuse block symbol with the same name exists in the project library), deleting the PCB will also delete the associated schematic and reuse block symbol. If the reuse block symbol cannot be deleted, it will be skipped
